wholePhysicalScope: Mapped dam way 448005771 and its shared upstream shoreline with the named Upper Reservoir. The crest and outer shoulders use documented and mapped extents.
lodDetails: All four detail levels retain the complete granite gravity wall, abutments and crest walk. Near levels refine the ashlar coping and cast-iron rails.
limitations: The guide gives a 121.9 m main dam, and the appraisal gives about 150 m including its broader extent. The mapped slope and shared shoreline guide the model. The inspection walkway and individual course details remain estimated.

The published full water elevation is 152.31 m HKPD. The top and toe follow the unmodified original terrain and documented gravity section. The 1897 change is represented by the estimated raised crest and pale coping.
The historic valve house is an independently placed structure on part of the crest. The separate overflow works are beyond this dam’s physical footprint.
